cells.tense: Right now the whole picture of what you're carrying is in your hands, and standing in it isn't costing you anything.
cells.ask: Say the one thing you've been holding quietly, and let it count as done.
cells.core:
The whole shape of what you're holding is available to you, not just the pieces you've been handed. Nothing in it surprises you anymore, so the load sits in your arms instead of up in your shoulders, and you can put it down for an hour and pick it back up without losing the thread. This is what endurance gets to be when the seeing is finished: you hold and you rest in the same day, and neither one costs the other.

There's one thing you've been keeping to yourself, and keeping it is a low hum you've stopped hearing. Say it out loud once, to the person it concerns or to no one, and let it land as finished instead of pending. Nothing more gets asked of you on it.
cells.sheetLine: You can see it whole and still hold on.
cells.verb: seeing it whole, nothing left hidden
cells.place: under the weight you're carrying, holding steady

cells.tense: You're bracing for how this is all going to turn out, and the bracing starts long before anything has happened.
cells.ask: Meet one thing today with no idea how it goes.
cells.core:
When this is working, you carry the weight and you stay curious about it. You don't need to know how the conversation ends before you walk in — you show up, you hold what needs holding, and the shape of the thing reveals itself while you're in it. That's endurance that stays open, and it doesn't wear you down the way the other kind does.

What you're doing now is answering every question before it's asked. You've already run the ending, the objection, the way someone will take it, and you're carrying the answers like armor. None of that keeps you steady — it just spends you ahead of time. Try one thing today with the outcome left blank: no preview, no plan for the turn it might take, just arrive and let it be new. What you're protecting will hold without the rehearsal.
cells.sheetLine: You're braced for an outcome you haven't been given.
cells.verb: seeing it whole, nothing left hidden
cells.place: under the weight you're carrying, holding steady

cells.tense: You saw something clearly a while back and you're still standing where you saw it, with your feet in the same spot.
cells.ask: Pick one thing you already see and act on it today.
cells.core:
You know exactly what needs doing. You've known. The seeing became waiting, and the waiting became standing still, and now the door you're facing is behind you and the surface under you hasn't changed. The clarity never left. The walking did.

When this is alive, you choose from what's in front of you and the choosing moves your feet — the decision and the step are the same motion, and you don't need the whole route to start. Take one thing you can already see and put your weight behind it today. The direction is there and it's yours. It just needs your hand on it.
cells.sheetLine: You see it clearly, but you've stopped moving on it.
cells.verb: seeing it whole, nothing left hidden
cells.place: under the weight you're carrying, holding steady

cells.tense: You already see this whole thing clearly, you've seen it for a while, and you keep talking about it like the light is coming from somewhere else.
cells.ask: Say out loud that what you see is yours, once, to one person.
cells.core:
You have the full picture. Nothing here is hidden from you, and the calls you make about it turn out right often enough that the carrying gets easier the clearer you get. That's how this works when it's owned: you hold what you hold, and you know it's your hands doing the holding.

The part that hasn't arrived is the claiming. The work gets credited to timing, to luck, to the situation being obvious. None of those saw it. You did. Tell one person that this is what you see, plainly, with no credit handed off and no source named. It was never borrowed.
cells.sheetLine: You're the one who sees it. You've been calling it something else.
cells.verb: seeing it whole, nothing left hidden
